# Fate UI v0.9.7-beta4

This beta fixes session navigation races, misleading activity in restored sessions, and local file links in chat.

## Changes since v0.9.7-beta3

- Opening a folder and selecting or creating a session now happen in one queued operation. Rapid clicks no longer leave a session request competing with another folder change. The sidebar ignores stale responses and duplicate in-flight clicks, and you can move to another folder while session creation finishes.
- The built-in browser now waits for its first tab to finish initializing before accepting navigation. This fixes a startup race that could leave local previews blank on macOS.
- Restored tool calls without a recorded result no longer appear to be running. They show an interruption notice instead. Opening a saved session does not resume those calls; running indicators require live execution events.
- Local file links in assistant messages now reveal the file in your system file manager. Relative paths, local file URLs, Windows paths, and sandbox-prefixed paths work when they resolve to a file inside the active project. Missing files produce an error, and paths outside the project remain blocked. Clicking a link does not execute the file.

The navigation fix adds no background polling or session cache and does not keep extra sessions loaded. Existing session loading and eviction behavior stays unchanged.

## Downloads and verification

The release pipeline runs native checks, builds, and installer smoke tests on Windows x64, macOS Apple Silicon, macOS Intel, and Linux x64 before publishing. Downloads include a Windows installer, DMG and PKG installers for both Mac architectures, and Linux AppImage and DEB packages.

Public beta installers are unsigned. Verify downloads against `SHA256SUMS` and back up important work before upgrading.
